description_en: Enables one or more alert rules
description_zh: 调用EnableMetricRules接口启用一个或多个报警规则
name: EnableMetricRules

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert rule.

Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an alert rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114941.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警规则ID。

N的取值范围：1~100。

关于如何获取报警规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114941.html
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to precheck only this request. Valid values:
true: sends a check request and does not associate a security group with the instance. The check items include whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): sends a regular request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is directly performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会为实例绑定安全组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, and you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参阅如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en:
The status code.

A status code of 200 indicates success

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.
false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。
false：失败
